# Sendbird

Sendbird is a platform that provides chat, voice, and video APIs to help businesses build in-app communication features.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sendbird/.

## Actions

- **Ban User from Group Channel**: Ban a user from a group channel.
- **Create Group Channel**: Create a new group channel.
- **Create Sendbird User**: Create a new user.
- **Issue Session Token**: Issue a session token for a user.
- **List Group Channels** (read-only): List group channels.
- **List Users** (read-only): Retrieve a list of users.
- **Revoke All Session Tokens**: Revoke all session tokens for a user.
- **Send Message**: Send a message to a group channel.
- **Unmute User**: Unmute a user in a group channel.
- **Add Members To Group Channel**: Add members to a group channel.
- **Delete Group Channel**: Delete a specific group channel.
- **Delete Message**: Delete a specific message in a sendbird group channel.
- **Delete Sendbird User**: Delete a sendbird user.
- **Get Count Preference Of Channel** (read-only): Retrieve a user's count preference for a specific group channel.
- **Leave Group Channels**: Leave group channels for a user.
- **List Banned Members** (read-only): List banned members in a group channel.
- **List Group Channel Members** (read-only): List members of a group channel.
- **List Group Channel Operators** (read-only): List operators of a group channel.
- **List Open Channel Operators** (read-only): List operators of an open channel.
- **List Operators by Custom Channel Type** (read-only): List operators of a channel by custom channel type.
- **Mark All User Messages As Read**: Mark all of a user's messages as read in group channels.
- **Mute User**: Mute a user in a group channel.
- **Register Group Channel Operators**: Register one or more users as operators in a sendbird group channel.
- **Register Operators by Custom Channel Type**: Register users as operators to channels by custom channel type.
- **Register Operators to Open Channel**: Register operators to an open channel.
- **Sendbird Get Group Channel Count by Join Status** (read-only): Retrieve number of group channels by join status for a user.
- **Sendbird Get Unread Item Count** (read-only): Retrieve a user's unread item counts.
- **Sendbird Update Message**: Update an existing group channel message in sendbird.
- **Sendbird View Group Channel** (read-only): View information about a specific group channel.
- **Sendbird View Message** (read-only): View a specific message in a group channel.
- **Sendbird View User** (read-only): View user information.
- **Unban User from Group Channel**: Unban a user from a group channel.
- **Unregister Operators Custom Channel Type**: Unregister operators from channels by custom channel type.
- **Update Count Preference Of Channel**: Update a user's unread count preference for a specific group channel.
- **Update Group Channel**: Update group channel information.
- **Update Sendbird User**: Update a user's information.
- **View User** (read-only): Retrieve information about a specific sendbird user.
